text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув gives it her all, but
unfortunately is
unable to become Triple
Tiara champion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All the same, Эйр Грув's performance
astounds
Мэдзиро Добер and she becomes
the younger
Umamusume's ideal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув is happy to hear that Mejiro
Dober
wishes to aspire to surpass her.
She pulls herself
together and also aims
for greater heights.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
